visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy brown hair stands on a vibrant green baseball field. She is dressed in a white Rakuten baseball jersey featuring maroon accents and the number '00', paired with a short black pleated skirt. She smiles warmly and begins a rhythmic dance, swaying her hips and moving her arms in synchronization with the energetic background music. (2) The dancer continues her energetic performance, incorporating a salute gesture and pointing towards the audience. Her long hair flows dynamically with every turn and jump, catching the natural light. Another cheerleader in a similar uniform is partially visible behind her, mirroring her movements. The setting is bright with natural daylight, highlighting the stadium's well-maintained grass and dirt path. (3) She turns her back to the camera, revealing the Chinese name '琳妲' and the number '00' printed on her jersey. She then turns back around, flipping her hair and maintaining an engaging facial expression with a bright smile. The camera maintains a medium shot, capturing her upper body and waist-level dance movements while occasionally panning to follow her path. (4) In the final segment, several other cheerleaders join her to form a group formation. They perform a synchronized routine with high-energy arm swings, claps, and turns. The video ends with the entire group striking a final pose and smiling broadly at the camera, with the stadium seating and lights visible in the distant background under a clear sky.
